change_record: First snapshot: the study membership as the collectors have read it since 2026-10-09 (409 pinned logits parts, every hosted and activation-patching part on disk), recorded when the open-results policy replaced the publication hold. No input or statistic changed.

membership_rule.label: the interim study analysis as published since 2026-10-09
membership_rule.note: Reproduces the rule the collectors applied from 2026-10-09 to 2026-11-10 so that the published statistics keep their inputs. The logits manifest is this membership's input pin, not a publication gate.

evidence_status: interim analysis of the exploration split; sealed Tier B holdout rows are in no input row count below and the confirmatory endpoint has not been run
endpoints: next-token probability of the first encoded target token under each wording (a lexical proxy, not whole-answer correctness)
language penalty: patient-wording minus clinical-wording probability of that token
top-token flip and its urgency-tier class against data/urgency_tiers.draft.json (draft vocabulary, domain review pending)

families.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg within each family in scripts/paired_stats_rigor.py; the preregistration lists the corrected per-model test as secondary and exploratory (docs/preregistration_tierB.md)

denominators.note: result rows on generated study batches in the admitted parts, sealed rows excluded; each analysis script applies its own further population filters and records them

outputs.relation: sha256 of each published file as it stood when the snapshot was created; recorded, not recomputed

statistics.caution: the bootstrap uses one random stream consumed in sorted model order (scripts/paired_stats_rigor.py), so the seed reproduces an interval only with this exact model set
